# Evaluation report (generated by `python scripts/eval.py --write`)

Fixture version: `fixtures-v1` / eval cases: `eval-cases-v1` / cases: 38

Both modes run the same scripted timelines against the simulators and are compared on **state and evidence**, not wording. The agent mode uses the deterministic `RulesPlanner` behind the tool-calling interface (no LLM credentials in this repository), so its numbers describe the tool loop, guardrail and budget, not a language model. Swap `OpenAICompatibleModel` in to measure a real model with the same harness.
